Definition: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve
BiblicalUsage: Yâthar means what is left over, the remnant that remains. Cities were given to the sons of Kohath that were left of the family, and Solomon counted the people left of the Amorites and Hittites and Perizzites who were not of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God always keeps a remnant, and what is left is never lost to Him.
